adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, the booking attendees are persisted first via prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...) and only afterwards the external calendar is updated with eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking). There is no surrounding transaction/compensating rollback, and updateCalendarAttendees is not in a try/catch, so a calendar update failure would throw after the DB write, leaving the new attendees saved in the DB but not reflected on the calendar (inconsistent state).
